statements.statement: CPT 93271 (cardiac event monitoring) was ordered for the patient
The patient has a history of recurrent palpitations and episodes of syncope (R55)
Clinical evaluation identified paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0) as a potential etiology
Clinical evaluation identified supraventricular tachycardia (I47.1) as a potential etiology
The monitor is required to capture rhythm data during symptomatic episodes to guide further management
No shorter-duration recording can capture these intermittent events
The service was denied with reason code PR-204
